list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.query: SELECT started_at::text || ' / ' || left(session_id::text, 8) AS __text, session_id::text AS __value FROM pilot.sessions ORDER BY started_at DESC

options.content: Choose a **database** and **session**. Speed, temperature, and voltage arrive at independent rates. Ranges of **5 minutes or less show raw observations**; longer ranges show **sample averages**. Counts below come from stored rows. Use the benchmark report to compare performance.

panels.title: Motor speed
panels.description: Raw observations up to 5 minutes; weighted sample averages for longer ranges. Summary buckets are timestamped at their start.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time, COALESCE(value_float, value_int::double precision) AS value
FROM pilot.measurements
WHERE session_id = NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, '')::uuid AND signal_id = 1
  AND quality = 'valid' AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND $__range_s <= 300
UNION ALL
SELECT date_bin((GREATEST($__interval_ms, 1000)::text || ' milliseconds')::interval,
                bucket, TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01') AS time,
       sum(sum_value) / NULLIF(sum(sample_count), 0) AS value
FROM pilot.measurements_1s
WHERE session_id = NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, '')::uuid AND signal_id = 1
  AND $__timeFilter(bucket) AND $__range_s > 300
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.name AS signal, r.hz AS "Source Hz", count(m.sample_id) AS "Stored observations"
FROM pilot.sessions AS session
JOIN pilot.signals AS s ON s.schema_id = session.schema_id
JOIN pilot.session_rates AS r ON r.session_id = session.session_id AND r.signal_id = s.signal_id
LEFT JOIN pilot.measurements AS m ON m.session_id = session.session_id
  AND m.schema_id = s.schema_id AND m.signal_id = s.signal_id AND $__timeFilter(m.ts)
WHERE session.session_id = NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, '')::uuid
GROUP BY s.name, r.hz ORDER BY r.hz DESC

SELECT ts AS time, schema_id, signal_id, sample_id,
       COALESCE(value_float, value_int::double precision) AS value, quality
FROM pilot.measurements WHERE session_id = NULLIF(${session:sqlstring}, '')::uuid AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts DESC, signal_id LIMIT 30
